$comment: K-5 (process-compute spec §3.3, §6): the process-run executor backends a deployment selects with PROCESS_EXECUTOR, and the one used when it is unset. The value is what process_runs.executor_backend holds for a run that backend admitted. Readers: the pipeline's config.PROCESS_EXECUTORS / DEFAULT_PROCESS_EXECUTOR and the app's app/src/lib/processes/executor.ts (the hardware-profiles route reports it).
